## site.create

Create a new site in the program of this token's site, seeded from a blueprint (`blueprintId`, default `blank`: an empty home page with the theme's header and footer; the site's theme is the blueprint's). With `brand` (the brand.setup input), the new site's draft design system gets that brand in the same transaction, so the site is created branded or not at all. Answers the new site; this token stays scoped to its own site, so edit the new one with a token minted for it. Run it alone in a batch with the `site` base revision; it is not undoable (delete the site from the admin).

- permission `site.admin` (admin); class `transaction`; writes `site`; **not undoable**: alone in its batch.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string (min 1, max 255) | yes |
| `slug` | string (min 1, max 100) | yes |
| `blueprintId` | string (min 1, max 100) |  |
| `brand` | object |  |
| `brand.primary` | string | yes |
| `brand.secondary` | string | yes |
| `brand.neutral` | string | yes |
| `brand.headingFamily` | string (min 1)[] | yes |
| `brand.bodyFamily` | string (min 1)[] | yes |
| `brand.typeRatio` | 1.125 \| 1.2 \| 1.25 \| 1.333 | yes |
| `brand.baseSize` | integer ≥14 ≤22 | yes |
| `brand.spaceBase` | 4 \| 8 | yes |
| `brand.radius` | "sharp" \| "soft" \| "round" \| "pill" | yes |
| `defaultLocale` | locale |  |

Output: { site: { id: string, slug: string, name: string, theme: string, blueprintId: string, programId?: string, parentSiteId?: string \| null, mountPath?: string \| null, domain?: string, createdAt: string, updatedAt: string } }

Example input:

```json
{"name":"Studio","slug":"studio","blueprintId":"blank","brand":{"primary":"#1e3d4f","secondary":"#c8553d","neutral":"#737373","headingFamily":["DM Sans","sans-serif"],"bodyFamily":["DM Sans","sans-serif"],"typeRatio":1.25,"baseSize":17,"spaceBase":4,"radius":"soft"}}
```

## site.updateLanguages

Set the site's languages: the whole list (`locales`, 1 to 12 locale codes) and the default (`defaultLocale`, one of them). An added language changes only the list: pages show the default's text in it until translated. A removed language is swept out of every draft locale map (page fields and trees, menus, collections and items, site settings, forms, media texts); a value only that language had moves to the default. Removing a language needs `confirmed: ["destructive"]`; the current default cannot be removed (make another language the default first). A new default first gets the old default's value wherever it has none. Published versions change at the next publish. Answers the languages and, per removed language, how many values it lost or moved. Run it with the `site` base revision; it is not undoable.

- permission `site.admin` (admin); class `transaction`; writes `site`; **not undoable**: alone in its batch.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `locales` | locale[] (≤12) | yes |
| `defaultLocale` | locale | yes |

Output: { locales: locale[], defaultLocale: locale, removed: { locale: locale, values: integer ≥0 }[] }

Example input:

```json
{"locales":["it","fr"],"defaultLocale":"it"}
```

> Needs `site.admin`: only a platform admin's token. An editor or workspace owner asks a platform admin to add or remove a language.
